svg.title: The maintenance shed at Winnipeg, half past four
svg.desc: A railway maintenance shed with two coaches and two rows of seats laid out on the floor between them, one row of worn cloth seats and one row of new synthetic seats still in plastic, with four people standing between them.

g.text: The maintenance shed at Winnipeg, half past four
Fourteen things to find. One of the new seats is already torn, and it has never been sat on.
the shed floor - two rows, twenty-two seats
a fitter - he has to put them in
the procurement officer - this year's budget
the old row - 1998, repaired four times
Nadia - she asked how long they last
the plastic the new covers came in
the new row - and one is already torn
